verses.en: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.pt: Deus se compadeça de nós e nos abençoe, e faça resplandecer o seu rosto sobre nós,
verses.en_web: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. With corded instruments. A Psalm. A Song.> May God give us mercy and blessing, and let the light of his face be shining on us; (Selah.)

verses.en: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.pt: para que se conheça na terra o seu caminho e entre todas as nações a sua salvação.
verses.en_web: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
verses.en_bbe: So that men may see your way on the earth, and your salvation among all nations.

verses.en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.pt: Louvem-te, ó Deus, os povos; louvem-te os povos todos.
verses.en_web: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.en_bbe: Let the peoples give you praise, O God; let all the peoples give you praise.

verses.en: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.pt: Alegrem-se e regozijem-se as nações, pois julgas os povos com eqüidade, e guias as nações sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: O let the nations be glad, and make song of joy; for you will be the judge of the peoples in righteousness, guiding the nations of the earth. (Selah.)

verses.en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.pt: Louvem-te, ó Deus, os povos; louvem os povos todos.
verses.en_web: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
verses.en_bbe: Let the peoples give you praise, O God; let all the peoples give you praise.

verses.en: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
verses.pt: A terra tem produzido o seu fruto; e Deus, o nosso Deus, tem nos abençoado.
verses.en_web: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
verses.en_bbe: The earth has given her increase; and God, even our God, will give us his blessing.

verses.en: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.pt: Deus nos tem abençoado; temam-no todas as extremidades da terra!
verses.en_web: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.en_bbe: God will give us his blessing; so let all the ends of the earth be in fear of him.
